moworks.notes: Both scenes slide one frame width with cubic-bezier(.9,0,.1,1) (almost still, a 6-frame dash, still again), 250 ms (8-14 frames); a horizontal smear hides the cut: recipe 1500 px in 6 frames + 8 px blur; the demo draws 4 trailing copies at 18 % opacity spaced 4 % of the width x sin(pi p). Params: duration (0.25 s) · ease (cubic-bezier .9,0,.1,1) · blur (8 px).
